verdict.rationale: Plausible documents an Events API that can record pageviews/custom events from web, mobile (iOS/Android), or server-side apps, and GitHub notes SPA/framework support, but there is no evidence of official first-party SDKs/libraries for specific languages (Swift, Kotlin, Node, Python, etc.) — only a generic HTTP API endpoint that developers must call themselves. missing for 10: official language-specific SDKs, mobile platform SDKs, backend client libraries, and any package registry entries (npm, pip, CocoaPods, etc.).
